{{Quote|The nature-loving Ithorians know a thing or two about what makes a great salad. This is our take on the traditional covado salad--mixed Ithorian greens garnished with starfruit and hard-boiled ooglata eggs. Served with Meerian vinaigrette.|Dex's Diner menu, on its herd ship's bounty salad|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Meerian vinaigrette''' was a type of [[Dressing/Legends|dressing]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Meerian/Legends|Meerian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served the [[Foodstuff/Legends|vinaigrette]] with its [[herd ship's bounty salad]]s.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Meerian vinaigrette was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
